title: Polynomial parameters with compatible coefficient equations and Artinian solution
statement: Let k:Type u be a field of characteristic p>0, A:Type v a finitely presented commutative k-algebra, Λ:Type w a Noetherian geometrically regular commutative k-algebra, α:A→Λ a k-algebra homomorphism and q a prime of Λ. Write L=Λ_q. Let N>0 satisfy m_L^N⊆α(singularIdeal k A)L, let d=spanFinrank(m_L), let a:Fin s→A generate singularIdeal k A, and let c>0. Put S=k[X_i:i∈Fin d]. There exist m, R=k[Y_i:i∈Fin m], compatible k-algebra structures S→R→Λ and S→Λ, coefficients ell:Fin d×Fin s→Λ and π:Fin(d+1)→R with the following properties. For each i, image(X_i)^(2N)=sum_j ell(i,j)α(a_j). Each π_i is zero or image(X_j^c) for some j, and maps into q. Multiplication by π_i and π_i² has the same kernel on R/(π_j^8:j<i) and on Λ/(image(π_j)^8:j<i). Put J=(π_i^8), Q=R_(q∩R), JQ the extension of J to Q and JL its extension through Λ to L, with the induced Q→L map. There exist n>0 and ideals I₀⊂R and K⊂L such that m_L^n⊆JL, I₀Q⊆JQ, K⊆JL and I₀L⊆K. There exist t and a local Artinian commutative ring D′ in Type(max u v), E=D′[T_i:i∈Fin t], compatible R,R/I₀,S,k algebra structures on E, with E essentially smooth over R/I₀, a k-algebra homomorphism f:A→E, coefficients μ:Fin d×Fin s→E and an R-algebra homomorphism b:E→L/K. For every i, image(X_i)^(2N)=sum_j μ(i,j)f(a_j) in E. For all x∈A, b(f(x)) is the image of α(x) in L/K; for every (i,j), b(μ(i,j)) is the image of ell(i,j) in L/K. The scalar towers are k→S→R, k→R→Λ, k→S→Λ, S→R→Λ, R→R/I₀→E, S→R→E and k→S→E. No presented algebra B, no map from B, and no equality of maps from B occurs in this statement. All notions are those of the stated dependencies.

proof.text: Apply lem-weil-pbc-popescu-parameter-coefficient-model to construct the rescaled parameters, kernel equalities, ideal bounds and raw Artinian model D′[t], together with injectivity on constants, coefficient inclusions and the evaluation map.

Use the R-algebra property of b and the scalar towers to identify b(image(X_i)) with the residue of image(X_i) in Λ. Apply the localization and quotient maps to the equation in Λ. Substitution of the images of t_i, f₀ and coeff gives the image of (u₀(i)δ_i)^(2N)=sum_j coeff(i,j)f₀(a_j). Injectivity on constants contracts this equation into D′. Multiply by δ_i^(-2N); distribute over the finite sum and cancel unit powers.

Define f=C composed with f₀ and μ(i,j)=C(coeff(i,j)δ_i^(-2N))t_i^(2N). Apply the constant ring homomorphism to the contracted equation, distribute the sum and multiply by t_i^(2N). This proves the required polynomial coefficient equation. Evaluate μ at δ_i and cancel unit powers to recover ell(i,j); evaluation of f follows from the model. Assemble these equations with the unchanged model data, taking t=d.

theorem exists_popescu_parameter_coefficients
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)).map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (d : ℕ) (hd : d =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).spanFinrank)
    (s : ℕ) (a : Fin s → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = singularIdeal k A)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    let S := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : Algebra S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : Algebra S Λ) (_ : IsScalarTower S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S Λ)
      (ell : Fin d × Fin s → Λ) (π : Fin (d + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
      (∀ i, algebraMap S Λ (MvPolynomial.X i) ^ (2 * N) =
        ∑ j : Fin s, ell (i, j) * α (a j)) ∧
      (∀ i, π i = 0 ∨ ∃ j : Fin d,
        π i = algebraMap S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (MvPolynomial.X j ^ c)) ∧
      (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin (d + 1))
        (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
          {y | ∃ j : Fin (d + 1), j.val < i.val ∧ y = π j ^ 8}),
        π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin (d + 1))
        (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
          {y | ∃ j : Fin (d + 1), j.val < i.val ∧
            y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π j) ^ 8}),
        π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin (d + 1) ↦ π i ^ 8))
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.asIdeal.under R) q.asIdeal
    let JQ := J.map (algebraMap R Q)
    let JL := (J.map (algebraMap R Λ)).map (algebraMap Λ L)
    ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ n ≤ JL ∧
      ∃ (I₀ : Ideal R) (K : Ideal L),
        I₀.map (algebraMap R Q) ≤ JQ ∧ K ≤ JL ∧
        (I₀.map (algebraMap R Q)).map (algebraMap Q L) ≤ K ∧
        ∃ (t : ℕ) (D' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D')
          (_ : IsLocalRing D') (_ : IsArtinianRing D'),
          let E := MvPolynomial (Fin t) D'
          ∃ (_ : Algebra R E) (_ : Algebra (R ⧸ I₀) E)
            (_ : IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ I₀) E)
            (_ : Algebra S E) (_ : IsScalarTower S R E)
            (_ : Algebra k E) (_ : IsScalarTower k S E),
            EssentiallySmooth (R ⧸ I₀) E ∧
            ∃ (f : A →ₐ[k] E) (μ : Fin d × Fin s → E)
              (b : E →ₐ[R] L ⧸ K),
              (∀ i, algebraMap S E (MvPolynomial.X i) ^ (2 * N) =
                ∑ j : Fin s, μ (i, j) * f (a j)) ∧
              (∀ x, b (f x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (α x))) ∧
              (∀ ij, b (μ ij) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (ell ij)))
